quiet: Smith and Jones found that salt intake raised blood pressure in most of the adults they studied.
Lee and Park repaired damaged retinas in mice using progenitor cells grown in the lab.
Garcia tracked obesity trends in rural Mexico for more than a decade.
Brown and Patel asked whether poor sleep harms memory in adolescents.
Novak measured the surface tension of several ionic liquids at room temperature.
Okafor surveyed malaria among children in Lagos during the rainy season.
Wilson followed heart failure patients for five years after bypass surgery.
Ahmed helped rural clinics run smoking cessation groups for farmers.
